threat_event: Ransomware encrypts clinical and business systems across multiple regions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Health care is a top target; large attack surface (20,000 endpoints, 159 sites); acquisition gaps (see R-003)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 to SYS-06; all tier-1 processes (P05)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 96% of endpoints; PAM; immutable backups; annual tier-1 DR tests; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Close acquisition gaps (R-003); EDR at AQ sites (POAM-013); LIS RTO fix (POAM-011); annual enterprise ransomware exercise including the disclosure committee (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: Exfiltration of PHI during a ransomware attack (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large PHI stores (EHR extracts, data warehouse, LIS); egress monitoring tuned for known patterns only
affected_asset_or_process: Data warehouse; LIS; file shares; EHR extracts
regulatory_driver: N62-R03 (164.404-164.410); state breach laws; SEC Item 1.05
existing_controls: Data loss prevention on email and web; egress alerting; database activity monitoring on the warehouse
treatment_plan: Egress anomaly models for cloud storage; data minimization in the warehouse (R-053)
key_risk_indicator: Large outbound transfers investigated; warehouse PHI record counts

threat_event: Attacker enters through an acquired practice's flat network and reaches enterprise systems over the site VPN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-06 to AQ-08 on legacy identity and flat networks; VPN reaches the interface engine (P07 SC-7 finding)
affected_asset_or_process: AQ-06 to AQ-08 sites; interface engines; LIS
existing_controls: Site VPNs; EDR at AQ-06 only
treatment_plan: Restrict VPN to named hosts; SD-WAN migration; identity federation (POAM-016; POAM-001)
key_risk_indicator: AQ sites on SD-WAN; AQ identities federated

threat_event: Former workforce member at an acquired practice keeps access after termination
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual terminations in legacy directories (2 of 60 sampled late)
affected_asset_or_process: AQ-06 to AQ-08 directories; LIS order entry; legacy EHRs
existing_controls: Daily HR report to local IT
treatment_plan: Federation into the identity platform; interim daily reconciliation (POAM-001)

threat_event: Primary clearinghouse outage or compromise stops 70% of claims and most eligibility checks for weeks
threat_source: Clearinghouse failure or attack on the clearinghouse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 70% concentration; no contracted surge capacity; manual fallback untested (P05 DEP-08)
existing_controls: Secondary clearinghouse for 18%; revolving credit facility
treatment_plan: Surge contract with the secondary clearinghouse; payer-portal fallback test (POAM-019)
key_risk_indicator: Share of claims on one clearinghouse; days of fallback capacity

threat_event: Attacker exploits an unsupported operating system on a networked medical device or analyzer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1,100 devices on unsupported OS; NAC at 60% of sites; 14 analyzer workstations (P07)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 medical devices; central lab analyzers
existing_controls: Device VLANs at NAC sites; network detection; vendor patch programs
treatment_plan: Document deviations; segment remaining sites; refresh plan for unsupported devices (POAM-009; POAM-018)

threat_event: Uninventoried medical devices go unpatched and unmonitored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inventory 85% complete; point-of-care device types missing (P07 CM-8)
treatment_plan: Passive discovery at all sites (POAM-010)

threat_event: Unauthorized device connected at a site without network access control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: NAC at 60% of sites; rogue device test undetected (P07 SI-4)
treatment_plan: NAC to all sites (POAM-018)

threat_event: Wrong lab results are released because an autoverification rule or test build change was not independently validated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rule changes approved inside the lab; build administrators can release results (P07 CM-3, AC-5)
existing_controls: Validation environment; technologist review of flagged results; delta checks
treatment_plan: Lab change board; role split; automated block (POAM-003); rule attribution (POAM-007)

threat_event: A result is filed to the wrong patient or field, or altered after verification, and nobody detects it
threat_source: Interface mapping error or malicious insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No LIS-to-EHR reconciliation; no SIEM use case for post-verification changes (P07 SI-7)
existing_controls: HL7 validation; error queues; corrected report process
treatment_plan: Daily reconciliation and integrity alerting (POAM-006)

threat_event: Attacker uses an analyzer vendor's always-on remote support tool to reach the lab network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor tools outside PAM on 4 of 9 platforms (P07 AC-17)
treatment_plan: Move sessions to the PAM vendor gateway (POAM-004)

threat_event: Care management risk model under-identifies high-need patients in some groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bias tested only on vendor-supplied data; model uses age and sex inputs (P10 AI-005)
existing_controls: Care manager review of outreach lists
treatment_plan: Local bias testing on the group's own data (POAM-020)

threat_event: AI use cases run without council review, so risks are not identified before use
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 of 14 use cases not reviewed (P10)
treatment_plan: Complete the 5 reviews (POAM-020)
key_risk_indicator: Use cases in production without review

threat_event: AI scribe records a visit without valid consent or inserts a clinically significant error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 650 providers enrolled; consent documentation uneven across states
regulatory_driver: N62-R01 (164.308(b)(1)); state recording laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03 worked example)
existing_controls: BAA with no-training terms; provider signs every note
treatment_plan: Enterprise all-party consent standard; monthly note sampling (P10)
key_risk_indicator: Consent documentation rate; critical error rate

threat_event: AQ-07 or AQ-08 legacy EHR fails and a day of clinical data is lost
threat_source: Hardware, software, or ransomware at the practice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly backups only (RPO 24 h vs 15 min); no tested restore (P05 BP-17)
treatment_plan: Restore test and offsite copy before migration; accelerate migrations (2026-11-30; 2027-04-30)

threat_event: Workforce snooping in the AQ-07 or AQ-08 EHR goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No audit feeds to the SIEM (P07 AU-6)
existing_controls: Local audit logs exist but are not reviewed
treatment_plan: Interim weekly review; SIEM collectors (POAM-005)

threat_event: A material incident is disclosed late or inaccurately because the materiality process fails under pressure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality playbook not exercised with the disclosure committee since the 2025 acquisitions (P07 IR-8)
existing_controls: Playbook exists; General Counsel chairs the committee
treatment_plan: Update playbook; brief new members; full tabletop 2026-11-12 (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: Days since last disclosure committee exercise

threat_event: Insiders trade on nonpublic incident information before disclosure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Incident facts spread across many responders
regulatory_driver: SEC insider trading rules; company insider trading policy
treatment_plan: Automatic special blackout when the disclosure committee convenes (P08 step 6.4)

threat_event: The annual Item 106 disclosure describes processes that do not operate as described
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Item 106 text drafted by legal from policy documents
treatment_plan: Internal Audit tests each Item 106 statement against evidence before filing

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts a vendor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High payment volume; vendor bank change requests by email
treatment_plan: Vendor bank changes only through the supplier portal with call-back
key_risk_indicator: Bank change requests outside the portal

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many cloud accounts across two providers
treatment_plan: Residual Moderate accepted by the CISO; monitored by SIEM use cases

threat_event: Cloud misconfiguration exposes the data warehouse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two clouds; many data pipelines
existing_controls: Posture management; deny public access guardrail
treatment_plan: Extend preventive guardrails to data pipeline accounts
key_risk_indicator: Critical posture findings open over 7 days

threat_event: API flaw in the patient-app platform exposes another client practice's patients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Multi-tenant platform for 45 client practices
treatment_plan: Tenant-isolation tests in every release pipeline

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over patient-app accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1.3 million users; password reuse
treatment_plan: Risk-based MFA for all patient accounts

threat_event: A third party with PHI suffers a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 320 vendors with PHI; only tier-1 vendors assessed annually; 23 inherited contracts unreviewed
treatment_plan: Review inherited contracts (POAM-022); continuous monitoring of tier-1 and tier-2 vendors

threat_event: EHR vendor outage longer than 4 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single vendor-hosted instance
existing_controls: Contract RTO 4 h; read-only downtime service; observed failover test
treatment_plan: Quarterly downtime drills at clinics

threat_event: Workforce member views records without a job need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12,000 workforce with EHR access
treatment_plan: Tune analytics for VIP and co-worker lookups

threat_event: Hurricane closes Florida sites and threatens colocation DC-1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida and South Carolina exposure; DC-1 in Florida
existing_controls: DC-2 replica in Georgia; generators; ASC emergency plans
treatment_plan: Annual hurricane exercise before June; fuel contracts

threat_event: Carrier outage at a single-carrier site
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41 sites single carrier
treatment_plan: Residual Low accepted

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in a trusted vendor software update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hundreds of applications; vendor update channels
existing_controls: EDR; code signing checks for key software; staged rollout
treatment_plan: Staged rollout for tier-1 software; SBOM requests for tier-1 vendors

threat_event: LIS recovery takes longer than the 4-hour RTO in a real outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DR test recovered in 5.5 h (P07 CP-10)
treatment_plan: Automation and retest (POAM-011)

threat_event: SOX IT general control deficiency in ERP access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complex ERP roles
treatment_plan: Quarterly SoD conflict review

threat_event: Payroll direct deposit diverted through HR account takeover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Self-service direct deposit changes
treatment_plan: Residual Low accepted

threat_event: Outreach portal account misused by a former client staff member or shared login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 612 inactive accounts; 11 clients share logins; MFA gaps (P07 IA-8)
treatment_plan: Disable inactive; remove shared logins; enforce MFA (POAM-002)

threat_event: Theft of an unencrypted workstation at an acquired practice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 310 AQ workstations unencrypted
treatment_plan: Encryption rollout (POAM-023)

threat_event: PHI shared with an inherited vendor that has no BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 inherited contracts unreviewed
treatment_plan: Review and execute BAAs (POAM-022)

threat_event: Courier and specimen tracking vendor fails or is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC report; no tested fallback (P05 DEP-14)
treatment_plan: Vendor assessment (POAM-015); fallback drill

threat_event: Ransomware or outage in the PACS environment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PACS in colocation DC-1
existing_controls: Replica in DC-2; modality local storage
treatment_plan: Immutable PACS backup copy

threat_event: ASC cannot operate safely during an EHR or network outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ASC exercises have not included a cyber scenario; downtime training gaps at 2 ASCs
treatment_plan: Cyber scenario in the next exercise; training (POAM-021)

threat_event: Complaint or review finds the group has not met 45 CFR 92.210 for its decision support tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Input-variable inventory incomplete; mitigation not documented
treatment_plan: 92.210 inventory and mitigation records (POAM-020)

threat_event: Workforce paste PHI into an unapproved generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public tools reachable from workstations
existing_controls: Approved enterprise AI assistant (AI-013) with BAA
treatment_plan: Block unapproved AI domains at the web gateway

threat_event: Patient-app virtual assistant gives unsafe or wrong information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generative model in a patient-facing channel
existing_controls: Scope limited to scheduling and FAQs; escalation to staff
treatment_plan: Monthly red-team testing and transcript sampling

threat_event: AI resume screening disadvantages applicants in a protected group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor feature enabled without review (AI-012)
regulatory_driver: Federal equal employment opportunity laws (company counsel)
treatment_plan: Ranking disabled 2026-08-15 until council review and adverse impact testing

threat_event: Denial of service on the patient app or outreach portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing
treatment_plan: Residual Low accepted

threat_event: PHI sent to the wrong recipient by email or fax
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High volume of referrals
treatment_plan: Recipient verification prompts

threat_event: Departing workforce member takes patient lists
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Report-writing rights in revenue cycle
treatment_plan: Bulk export review for departing staff

threat_event: Lost or stolen encrypted laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mobile workforce
treatment_plan: Residual Low accepted (encryption safe harbor for unsecured PHI analysis)

threat_event: Zero-day in an internet-facing edge device (VPN or firewall) is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge devices at data centers and 14 AQ sites
treatment_plan: Retire legacy AQ edge devices with SD-WAN migration (POAM-016); emergency patch SLA 72 h

threat_event: Encryption keys are lost or deleted, making data unrecoverable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keys in two clouds
treatment_plan: Annual key recovery test

threat_event: Backups are destroyed along with production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Immutable backups in separate accounts
existing_controls: Write-once retention; separate accounts; weekly copy to DC-2
treatment_plan: Residual Moderate accepted by the CISO

threat_event: MSSP overflow access used to reach enterprise systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSSP analysts have SIEM access
treatment_plan: Annual MSSP assessment

threat_event: SOC staffing gap reduces 24x7 coverage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tight labor market
treatment_plan: Residual Low accepted

threat_event: Unmanaged copies of PHI accumulate in data warehouse extracts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Analysts export data sets
treatment_plan: Extract registration and 90-day expiry

threat_event: HIE interface sends records to the wrong organization
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many trading partners
treatment_plan: Partner routing tests at each change

threat_event: Part 2 records received from outside programs are redisclosed improperly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records not always flagged
treatment_plan: Training for health information management staff

threat_event: An EHR build change disables clinical decision support alerts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Frequent build changes
treatment_plan: Automated alert regression tests

threat_event: Logs are not available for an investigation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Varied retention in legacy systems
existing_controls: 1 year online; 6 years archive for enterprise systems
treatment_plan: Onboard AQ logs (POAM-005)

threat_event: Attacker uses default vendor passwords on analyzers to change settings or pivot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default service passwords on 3 analyzers (found in P07 testing)
treatment_plan: Change passwords and vault them (POAM-012)

threat_event: HL7 traffic on the lab segment is intercepted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unencrypted MLLP inside the lab segment (P07 SC-8)
treatment_plan: TLS after middleware replacement (POAM-017)

threat_event: An incident at an acquired practice is handled locally and escalated too late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Local IT outside SOC runbooks (P07 IR-4)
treatment_plan: Route reporting to the SOC; EDR (POAM-013)

threat_event: A future acquisition closes without security due diligence and integration funding
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025-2026 deals budgeted integration late
treatment_plan: Security due diligence and integration budget required in board deal approvals

threat_event: HIPAA Security Rule changes if the 2025 proposal is finalized
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Proposed rule (not in force) would add prescriptive requirements
treatment_plan: Track the proposal; pre-assess proposed requirements in P03 (pending_rule_change column); budget contingency in the 2027 plan

threat_event: Unauthorized person enters the central lab
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Busy specimen receiving area
treatment_plan: Residual Low accepted

threat_event: Telephony platform outage blocks scheduling and triage lines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single carrier
treatment_plan: Second carrier for main numbers

threat_event: National e-prescribing network outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single industry network
treatment_plan: Downtime prescribing drill each year
